note: Authored persona decisions for batch 2. The planner pins each signs and rejects entry as one set-belief and does not overwrite it. Unsigned is not the same as an explicit rejection. Eli's rejection of the abortion commonality is authoring intent. Sixteen modified-to-commonality arrows are allowed. The four abortion and schools arrows keep accepted-bridge-role-pair. The twelve draft arrows use live-attester-modified-to-commonality from campaigns/network-societies-v1-b2-implication-evaluations.json (deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, 2026-10-16). Designed-no pairs in that file stay unpublished. v4-flash returned empty content on longer pairs and was not used as a judgment. Delegated spending and a monthly pledge stay out of this campaign: the adapter can delegate and revoke a note, and Pat already does that with Ned, but nothing spends a delegated note or repeats a pledge.
